summary.text: Wayne Burton is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 10 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He previously served in the House from Strafford 6 and works in higher education administration.

paragraphs.text: Burton served in the U.S. Army and earned a bachelor's degree from Bowdoin College, a master's degree from the University of New Hampshire and a graduate degree from Vanderbilt University.
His career experience includes working in higher education administration.

Burton previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Strafford 6 from 2014 to 2018, when Cam Kenney succeeded him, and was assigned to the Education and Election Law committees in the 2015 and 2017 sessions.
He returned to the House in 2024 after advancing from the Democratic primary for Strafford 10, and he advanced from the Democratic primary again on September 8, 2026.
